name: PROD01_FourBitExceptionSeqlock
hypothesis: Combines 4-bit semantic nibbles, dynamic 16-slot class dictionary, sparse rare-pattern escape on slot 0x0F, and 48,829 page seqlocks to achieve tear-free linearizability, open-world safety, and under 27 MB static memory on 50M accounts.
statusReason: Exhaustively verified on 50M PostgreSQL records with 400M checks (100% parity, SHA-256 verified), 14 concurrency gates passed, and 100-batch latency sampled (53 ns p50).

name: SEM03_FourBitSemanticClasses
hypothesis: Packs 4-bit semantic equivalence class IDs (2 per byte) into 25.00 MB decimal, using lock-free Interlocked byte mutation.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 1M, 10M, and 50M records (37.85 Mops/s ST read, 21 ns p50, 88.7 Mops/s MT8, 182.4 Mops/s adjacent CAS).

name: COMBO02_SemanticClassesWithRareExceptions
hypothesis: 4-bit semantic classes covering >99.99% accounts with sparse hash table fallback on slot 0x0F for open-world safety.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M and 50M records (26.88 Mops/s ST read, 40 ns p50, 81.18 Mops/s MT16, 98.75 Mops/s Zipf).

name: SEM02_ByteAnswerVector
hypothesis: Contiguous byte array where 1 byte stores all 8 query answers directly, eliminating class translation.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M and 50M records (38.10 Mops/s ST read, 24 ns p50, 218.95 Mops/s MT8, 50.0 MB memory).

name: REP01_CorrelatedOutcomeJointBitmap
hypothesis: Stores joint 8-query answer patterns as packed bytes with direct bit extraction.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M and 50M records (33.64 Mops/s ST read, 22 ns p50, 90.0 Mops/s MT8, 115.94 Mops/s MT16).

name: SEM01_IndependentBitmaps
hypothesis: Baseline: 8 independent 1-bit boolean bitmaps (6.25 MB per 50M each, 50.0 MB total).
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M and 50M records (10.74 Mops/s ST read, 94 ns p50, 78.60 Mops/s MT8, 105.78 Mops/s MT16).

name: REC03_SeqlockPagePublication
hypothesis: 1024-account pages with 64-bit seqlocks preventing torn reads during multi-byte mutations.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M and 50M records (20.74 Mops/s ST read, 50.78 MB memory, zero torn reads across 11.6M writes).

name: REP02_FactorizedSharedConditionGraph
hypothesis: Stores 6 orthogonal condition atoms in bitmaps; evaluates composite predicates via an expression DAG.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M records (7.15 MiB / 6.0 bits/acc, 36.41 Mops/s MT read).

name: COMBO04_SharedAtomsWithBatchIntermediateReuse
hypothesis: Shared atomic condition bitmaps with batch SIMD intermediate sub-expression reuse.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M records (7.15 MiB, 59.90 Mops/s MT read).

name: COMBO01_FactorizedAtomsWithDargAndFreshness
hypothesis: Shared atomic condition bitmaps with dependency recompute and epoch clocks.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M records (7.15 MiB, 32.86 Mops/s MT read).

name: REC02_CheckpointedContiguousPrefixReplay
hypothesis: Checkpoint snapshots paired with contiguous outbox log replay from safe watermark.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M records (20.0 MB, 92.83 Mops/s MT read, verified zero gap stalls).

name: COMBO06_CompletePortfolioRouter
hypothesis: Complete adaptive portfolio router dynamically dispatching queries between point lookups, scans, and recovery engines.
statusReason: Benchmarked on 10M records (25.0 MB, 64.70 Mops/s MT read).

name: THR02_BitSlicedNumericEvaluation
hypothesis: Bit-sliced columnar integers evaluated 64 accounts simultaneously with bitwise logic.
statusReason: Benchmarked on vector scan microbenchmarks and unit correctness suite.

name: THR01_ThresholdDecisionDirectory
hypothesis: Partitions balance domain into 6 intervals across 5 declared thresholds.
statusReason: Verified against pure-code oracle and benchmarked against bit-sliced comparator.

name: THR03_IntervalVsBitSlicedComparator
hypothesis: Automated benchmark comparing interval directory vs bit-sliced numeric SIMD evaluation.
statusReason: Screening benchmarks executed and verified against oracle.

name: SEM05_DictionaryEncodedAnswerVectors
hypothesis: Global dictionary mapping rare 8-bit patterns with frequency sorting.

name: SEM06_SparseRareClassExceptions

name: SEM07_BlockLocalSemanticDictionaries
hypothesis: 64KB block-local dictionaries adapting to spatial clustering.
